title: How to Watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival Stream Online for Free
summary: The annual festival will take place on Friday, Sept. 18, and Saturday, Sept. 19, in Las Vegas, with the option to stream for free online for eligible customers.
contentText:

You may “heart” radio, but instead, it’s time to turn the TV on because fans who can’t make the iHeartRadio Music Festival this weekend can stream the full lineup at home. The 2026 festival takes over the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas on Friday, Sept. 18 and Saturday, Sept. 19, with BTS , Cardi B , Benson Boone , Ciara , LE SSERAFIM , Snoop Dogg , Muse , Lainey Wilson , Weezer and more on the bill, with Ryan Seacrest returning as host.

get 5-day free trial with directv

At a Glance: Where to Watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival

- Date & time: Friday, Sept. 18, and Saturday, Sept. 19, 2026, at 7:30 p.m. PT/10:30 p.m. ET.

- Streaming: Disney+ & Hulu and DirecTV (with the latter offering a free trial to new customers).

The 2026 iHeart lineup spans pop, K-pop, hip-hop, country, rock and dance, with BTS, Cardi B, Benson Boone, Goo Goo Dolls, Kenny Chesney, Lainey Wilson, Major Lazer, Muse, Snoop Dogg, The Smashing Pumpkins, Weezer and Zara Larsson among the announced acts. Moreover, the 2026 festival will make history by featuring the first K-pop girl group, with LE SSERAFIM taking the stage on Saturday, Sept. 19.

Below is a breakdown of each streaming platform plus the benefits of signing up.

DirecTV’s streaming packages range from 90+ channels in Entertainment to 185+ in Premier, covering live TV, sports, news, entertainment, kids and Spanish-language programming. Prices currently start at $59.99 per month for Entertainment during a promotional period, with higher tiers available. New customers can get a five-day free trial, and plans have no annual contract.

Disney+ and Hulu Bundle

$12.99 per month
Includes movies, TV shows, documentaries and original series.

The Disney+ and Hulu bundle costs $12.99 monthly with ads, while the premium version costs $19.99 per month and removes ads from the regular Disney+ and Hulu libraries. The services bring together Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars and National Geographic programming alongside Hulu Originals, current TV episodes, movies and kids content. Or select the Disney+ and Hulu with HBO Max package for $19.99 per month or Disney+ and Hulu with ESPN for $35.99 per month.

Customers can also make the most of a DirecTV Signature Package with Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Unlimited included at no additional cost when you have a Gemini device. Activate your TV package here .
